observation.visible_scene: An outdoor grassy area. A man in a dark green leather jacket, with a bruised/swollen left eye, stands at the left of the frame looking right. A second man, wearing a light gray jacket with a red blood-like stain on the chest and a small bandage on his forehead, stands opposite him on the right. A wooden pole is visible at the right edge early on; a green mesh cage/structure with bottles appears at the lower left later.
visible_changes: The second (light-jacket) man enters the frame from the right edge and becomes fully visible facing the first man.
The dark-jacket man raises his hand/fist to his mouth-nose area and holds it there for several frames (wiping or gesturing), then lowers it.
The dark-jacket man turns and moves across the foreground, his back/head growing larger and eventually occluding part of the second man.
The second man raises one arm/hand toward the green structure on the left near the end.
Framing shifts: the right-edge pole leaves view and the left green structure enters, indicating camera panning/tracking alongside the men's movement.
outside_clip_unknowns: What caused the facial bruise, the chest stain, and the forehead bandage is not shown.
Whether the hand-to-face motion is wiping blood or a pointing gesture is not resolved.
Any dialogue or the outcome after the excerpt is unseen.
uncertain_details: Exact direction and amount of camera motion vs. the men's own movement is hard to separate; background grass shifts consistently with a slow pan.
The dark-jacket man's arm action (wiping vs. gesturing/pointing) is ambiguous.
Relative depth/position of the two men changes partly due to the foreground man stepping across, not purely camera motion.
